capabilities.name: Core Policy Lifecycle Management
capabilities.description: Implements core policy operations including new business, adjustments, renewals, and cancellations, preserving premium rating and NCB calculations.

capabilities.name: Business-Led Product Configuration
capabilities.description: Provides administrative capabilities for business staff to configure motor, home, and small-commercial lines without IT developer involvement.

capabilities.name: Multilingual Document Generation
capabilities.description: Generates policy schedules, certificates, and renewal notices in Norwegian, Swedish, Danish, and English, integrated with OpenText Document Archive.

capabilities.name: Policyholder Self-Service Portal
capabilities.description: Delivers a modern digital portal for policyholders to view documents, update details, and submit first notice of loss.

capabilities.name: Claims Intake Handover
capabilities.description: Captures initial claim details and hands over claims adjudication to Guidewire ClaimCenter via REST and JMS protocols.

capabilities.validation_reason: Depends on the unconfirmed assumption of PL/SQL conversion to pgSQL.
capabilities.name: Database Migration & PL/SQL Modernization
capabilities.description: Migrates the 4.2 TB Oracle database to Azure Database for PostgreSQL, converting PL/SQL packages and meeting latency and DR targets.

capabilities.validation_reason: Depends on the unconfirmed assumption of using APIM SOAP-to-REST facade.
capabilities.name: Legacy Broker SOAP Gateway
capabilities.description: Maintains backward compatibility for legacy broker SOAP interfaces using Azure API Management as a SOAP-to-REST facade.

capabilities.name: Financial and Reporting Integrations
capabilities.description: Transmits daily financial premium postings to SAP S/4HANA and extracts nightly operational data feeds to the Corporate Data Warehouse.

capabilities.name: External Verification Integrations
capabilities.description: Integrates with external SOAP gateway for credit/sanctions screening and queries external vehicle registry over REST with throttling.

capabilities.name: Secure Cloud Platform & Compliance
capabilities.description: Deploys the platform to Azure landing zones in Norway East and West Europe, ensuring GDPR/DORA compliance, high availability, and zero-downtime deployments.

modules.name: Core Policy Administration
modules.description: Groups core policy operations, product configuration, and document generation capabilities.

modules.name: Digital Channels
modules.description: Groups customer-facing digital portals and self-service capabilities.

modules.name: Integration & Middleware
modules.description: Groups internal and external integrations, including broker SOAP services and claims handover.

modules.name: Data & Platform
modules.description: Groups database migration, secure cloud hosting, and compliance capabilities.

out_of_scope.text: Physical decommissioning of the Oslo Data Centre.
out_of_scope.reason: The scope is strictly limited to software and data migration to Azure; physical cleanup is handled by a third party.

out_of_scope.text: Full modernization or rewrite of Guidewire ClaimCenter.
out_of_scope.reason: The project only covers integration with the existing ClaimCenter system, not its modernization.
